odc_type: Logic error in linear programming tableau variable assignment
observation_summary: The SimplexSolver returns a negative value for a variable despite the 'restrictToNonNegative' flag being enabled.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs in the SimplexSolver when handling variables with zero coefficients in the objective function. The solver incorrectly assigns negative values to these variables even when the 'restrictToNonNegative' flag is set to true. The fix involves explicitly checking if the basic row corresponds to the objective function row (index 0) and setting the coefficient to zero in that case, ensuring that unconstrained variables that are still part of the objective function are handled correctly during the tableau optimization process.
